slides.title: Your brain is *always guessing.*
slides.sub: Even while you listen, it's predicting what comes next.

slides.title: What the study did
slides.body: People listened to stories while researchers recorded their brain activity, then estimated how predictable each word was.

slides.title: What they found
slides.body: Unexpected words drew stronger brain responses. The predicting ran at many levels, from meaning and grammar to speech sounds.

slides.title: It never switched off
slides.body: The lead researcher put it this way: the predictive machinery is always turned on.

slides.title: Catch one guess
slides.body: Today, notice a moment you finish someone's sentence in your head. Then let them finish. Were you right?
